item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.5 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.5 Preview
- Settings now includes **The Legacy Lab**, with buttons for the app directory and Sam Hurd on Patreon. - Choose **Gainmap**, **The Epic Workflow**, **Secondlight**, **Insight**, or **LeadLens**, then click **Open Link**. Gainmap and The Epic Workflow open their Patreon download posts. Links open in your browser and keep your Settings choices available until you save or cancel. - The downloaded plug-in folder is now **CleanSweep.lrplugin**, and Plug-in Manager displays **Clean Sweep**. Saved queues, preferences, and the update connection use the same internal identifier. - Includes the 0.6.4 fix for the Mac update-location warning, along with the direct ZIP **Download** button.
**Upgrading from RemovalQueue.lrplugin:** finish or stop your batch and close the status window. Disable the old plug-in, move its folder out of Lightroom's Modules folder if installed there, and add/enable the new CleanSweep.lrplugin from its permanent location. Remove the old registration if it remains listed; keep only the new copy enabled. Alternatively, rename the downloaded folder to RemovalQueue.lrplugin before replacing the old folder in place, then reload it in Plug-in Manager. Keep the Mac companion inside the complete plug-in folder.
If your current version still shows the Mac download-location warning, download this ZIP manually once. Native Lightroom checks of the new Settings section and folder registration remain manual acceptance steps.
